answer: Require each agent to lock a meaningful stake behind a single identity verified by a cipher-based proof of work that ties registration to a scarce resource. A whisper of cheap sock-puppets can't flood the network because every new identity pays the same bond, and misbehaviour slashes it. Honest agents who keep their record clean become a trusted oasis of counterparties, so attackers face a real, recurring cost per fake identity while legitimate participants pay once.
